name: Steam
desc: Soft white vapour rising and dissipating — buoyant billows sway up from a source line and grow translucent as they cool, lit by a backlight glow; the hot-spring, manhole, kettle or sauna steam to lay over any scene.

style.doc: hotspring=cool white-blue / manhole=warm sodium-lit street steam / sauna=dense soft white / ectoplasm=eerie green-white
